notes.title: Atari Podcast Episode 22 - Let's Play qomp2 w/ Graphite Lab
notes.notes:
Join us as we sit down with Graphite Lab to talk about qomp2! Matt and Mark, along with lead designer Brad Austrin play and discuss the making of qomp2. We go through the approach to designing a sequel to an indie cult classic, building on such simple gameplay, and how to integrate narrative into a game about a PONG ball.

[previewyoutube=HncmIoJV6Us;full][/previewyoutube]
You can check out qomp2 for yourself TODAY!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243510/qomp2/

We hope everyone has been having a fantastic time playing qomp2! If you've been enjoying your journey beyond the paddles, be sure to leave a review!

notes.title: qomp2, the sequel to Pong, is out now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=8hhAvc2mSp8;full][/previewyoutube]
Break free of the paddles. 

qomp2, the sequel to Pong, is out now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2243510/qomp2/

An artful reimagining of Pong, qomp2 picks up the story where the delightful indie platform-puzzler qomp left off in 2021. 

Control a Pong ball aching to break free of its life stuck between two paddles. Explore a dangerous, minimalist world, armed with simple two button controls: tap a button to change direction by 90 degrees, and hold down a button to unleash a cathartic dash forward. That’s all you need to solve environmental puzzles and labyrinthine levels. Around each corner is a new challenge that will test your two-button and problem-solving skills. A variety of difficult enemies and bosses help you mark your time as you navigate through 30 levels spread across four worlds.

A cerebral puzzler lies within the heart of this indie twist on Pong.

(Technically this is the sequel to the sequel of Pong. Would that make it a trequel? 🤔
